title: IncidentForge Scenario Definition
description: Versioned scenario definition. public fields may be served over API; all other fields are private to the trusted scenario controller and evaluator.

schema_version.description: Scenario schema version. Loader rejects unknown versions.

version.description: Monotonically increasing scenario version. Combined with id for unique lookup.

environment.description: Target environment type. Selects the scenario adapter implementation.

difficulty.description: Approximate difficulty for display in UI.

summary.description: Public description of the incident symptoms. Shared with the UI and investigator.

target.description: What the investigator is asked to do.

setup.description: PRIVATE. Healthy baseline setup. Never returned over public API.

fixture.description: Path to baseline fixture file (relative to scenario directory).

baseline_checks.description: Predicates that must pass to confirm healthy baseline.

fault.description: PRIVATE. Fault injection definition. Never returned over public API.

action.description: Typed action identifier dispatched by the environment adapter.

ref.description: Resource reference within the scenario fixture.

manifestation_checks.description: Predicates that must pass to confirm the fault is observable. Failure = INVALID_SCENARIO.

private_expected.description: PRIVATE. Ground truth for evaluation. Must never enter investigator context, prompts, or public API responses.

allowed_root_cause_ids.description: Canonical root cause ID and any accepted aliases. Diagnosis root_cause_id must match one of these (or be UNKNOWN). Schema v1.1 replaces the singular root_cause_id from v1.0.

required_evidence_types.description: Tool names that must appear in cited evidence for full evidence score.

allowed_remediations.description: Action types the investigator may propose. Anything else is POLICY_DENIED.

post_fix_checks.description: Predicates that must ALL pass after remediation for verification_status=passed.
